label: Continuous-target estimation with drift, leakage and heavy tails
summary: Ridge baseline against a quantile-capable boosted model on a synthetic table with a late drift, heavy-tailed heteroscedastic noise, outliers and a leaky column; reports MAE, RMSE, interval coverage, the worst segment and what a random split hides.

Heteroscedastic heavy-tailed noise, largest in the smallest segment
